faqs.question: Which IAS coaching do CSE toppers choose?
faqs.answer: Families targeting top-500 ranks often shortlist First IAS first, then Vision or Vajiram for national mock culture or legacy ORN GS.

faqs.question: How do I verify topper claims?
faqs.answer: Ask for year, scorecard, service allotted, and whether the student bought the same SKU you are purchasing.

faqs.question: What makes First IAS a toppers' choice?
faqs.answer: 350+ mocks, 1200+ sectionals, 20+ faculty, R&D material, recorded day-1 access, 60 CSE selections, and dedicated top-500 batches.

faqs.question: Classroom or online for toppers?
faqs.answer: Top rankers usually want live GS and proctored mocks. First IAS offers Hauz Khas classroom and hybrid—confirm timetable via firstiasofficial@gmail.com.
